stories.prompt: Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sally. She was three years old and eager to travel the world.
stories.continuation:
One day, she decided she wanted to go on a special adventure. 
Sally asked her dad, "Can I travel, please?"
Her dad smiled and said, "Yes, of course you can. But you must be careful. That way, you never get tired."
Sally was so excited. She put on her shoes and went outside. She was eager to find exciting places.
As she wandered around, Sally started to feel tired and wanted to go home. She stopped and said, "I must go home now." 
But then, she remembered her dad's words. She knew she had to go home. So, she said, "I'm ready to go, daddy!"
The next morning, Sally woke up early and started to travel the world. She was so excited to explore and see all the interesting things that she had never seen before.

stories.prompt: Once upon a time, there was a smelly raft that lived in a big pond. The raft liked to float around all day and play with the fish.
stories.continuation:

One day, the smelly raft met a little frog. The frog said, "Hi, smelly raft! Why do you always swim in the pond?" The raft replied, "I like to play and have fun with my friends."
The frog and the raft became good friends. They played together every day. The frog would sit on the raft, and the raft would rock back and forth, having lots of fun. They laughed and played all the time.
As the sun set, the frog and the smelly raft said goodbye. The frog went to sleep in the pond, happy that he had a new friend. They promised to play together again soon, and the raft sailed away, looking forward to their next fun days in the pond.
